results.objective: Go to http://127.0.0.1:3000, click the Barrier Restore Cream product, click the 'Increase quantity' button twice so the quantity is 3, type 'BUY3SAVE10' into the 'Promo code' field, click 'Apply', and confirm the text 'Promo BUY3SAVE10 applied: 10% off' and that the pay button reads 'Pay $78.30'
results.summary:
Selected Barrier Restore Cream and increased the quantity to 3.
Entered the promo code BUY3SAVE10 and applied it.
The 10% discount was applied, and the payment button showed Pay $78.30.
